verdict.rationale: Lithic's own card-creation API documents creating physical cards with `shipping_address` and `product_id` parameters, so ordering physical cards through the API is covered at its core. Nothing in the pack covers the rest of the story. missing for 10: custom card art/personalization, bulk ordering, shipping method selection, shipment tracking, evidence that Lithic manages the manufacturer relationship, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can order personalized physical cards through the API — custom card art, bulk orders, shipping methods and tracking — without managing a card manufacturer relationship myself

citations.quote: Create a new virtual or physical card. Parameters `shipping_address` and `product_id` only apply to physical cards.
